org found NAME: init fields: id={G}, leader={FOUNDER}, ballot=0, tax-rate=0, treasurer=0, recruiter=0
create {REALM}-org-{G}-charter (content), write charter.md with placeholders bound
birth A_G (M3 funded birth; the founder holds its transfer grant)
office give ROLE S: write org field ROLE := S (leader signs; law.org clause 5)
ballot open Q A,B,C: init: id={N}, org={G}, office=Q, open=1, result=0, ncand=3, vote-0..7=0
install law.management ; law.ballot with {SEAT_k} bound to the roster in seat order, {OFFICER} = the opener, {TALLY} = the tally runner
ballot close: the tally runner runs programs/tally.hoon over the ballot's fields and writes result
treasury pay S N: a Book transfer from A_G signed under the treasurer's delegation (needs the transfer-delegation shape, offices.json)
